title: Five-step method card
subject: English Literature
unit: Summer 2: Unseen poetry (Component 1 Section A); mock
source: Seeded from english-literature/y10 lesson 20 (Five-step method card (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 20: Unseen poetry: a method for a poem you have never read. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To understand how a five-step method turns a first reading of an unseen poem into analysis of language, form and structure
equipment: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE English Literature (4ET1) specification and sample assessment materials (Component 1) (Section A: one 20-mark unseen poem, AO2)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Ask: who speaks, about what, what changes?
Plan three points: beginning, turn, end

questions.q: The last line compares the grandfather's belief to...
in the portal response box, write two analytical paragraphs on how the poet presents change. Starter: 'The poet presents change as...'
questions.a: Two paragraphs: method, short quotation, effect
questions.model: Point: change is presented as tiredness at first | Evidence: 'like old friends with nothing left to say' | Method: simile | Effect: the season feels worn out, gentle rather than harsh

questions.q: write a paragraph on the final stanza's shift in tone
